restaurant_name: Life Dental Clinic คลินิคทันตกรรมไลฟ์
text: As a result of many negative experiences, I used to loathe going to the dentist. Then I found Life Dental Clinic. It is by far the best dental clinic I have ever been to. The staff are super friendly and helpful. The dentists are all highly skilled, friendly, and gentle. They explain everything clearly and never try to force treatments, such as fillings, that you don't actually require. I have been to Life Dental Clinic many times and each time has been excellent  I will definitely be going back any time I need to see a dentist.

restaurant_name: Life Dental Clinic คลินิคทันตกรรมไลฟ์
text:
The orthodontist was excellent, very patient, and explained everything for over 30 minutes without complaining. He answered all my questions (Dr. Nek). The reception staff were also incredibly lovely, providing great service with polite and friendly service. They were always smiling and cheerful. 10/10 ***I highly recommend getting your braces done with a specialist orthodontist.***
>>> P.S. The equipment is modern and new, with a variety of materials to choose from depending on your budget. 🩷👍
